items.title: Verisk Stock Earnings Beat Has The Bull Case Changed?
items.summary: Verisk Analytics reported Q3 2026 revenue of US$809 million and net income of US$219.2 million, with adjusted earnings per share of US$1.96 exceeding analyst expectations and subscription activity highlighted as a key driver. The business leaned heavily on AI-powered insurance tools and a capital return program that included a US$100 million accelerated share repurchase and a higher dividend, underlining how data products and cash returns now work together in Verisk’s model. items.title: Verisk Analytics (VRSK) Earnings Beat Puts Its Pricey Narrative Back In Focus
items.summary: Verisk Analytics (VRSK) has put fresh numbers on the table, reporting third quarter 2026 sales of US$809 million and net income of US$219.2 million, giving investors updated insight into the insurance data specialist. The fresh earnings beat appears to have reset sentiment around Verisk Analytics, with a 1-day share price return of 6.88% and a 30-day share price return of 28.01% at US$211.47.
